verses.text: Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ha jun spuertail schab'il amak' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, ha t'a wake' k'ual munlajel, yowalil makannhej, anhej t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip sjakwi yet' t'a sk'ual yik tz'alji k'een uj.

Ha winh yajal chi' tz'och winh t'a jun puerta t'a b'ab'el amak', tz'och winh t'a jun corredor t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Tz'och linhan winh t'a smarcoal jun puerta chi', yakb'an wan snhusantz'a nok' silab' heb' sacerdote yet' nok' silab' yik junk'olal syak' winh. Slajwi chi' tz'och winh ejmelal t'ayin b'aj ayek' chi', ichato chi' tz'el winh t'a corredor chi', palta skannhej jakan jun puerta chi', masanto wanxo sq'uik'b'i smakchaji.
Haxo t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip yet' t'a yik tz'alji k'een uj, yowalil tzul och heb' chonhab' ejmelal t'ayin, t'a yichanh jun puerta chi'.
Ha nok' silab' yowalil syak' winh yajal chi' t'ayin yik snhusjitz'a t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, wakwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel, malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok' yukwanhil.

Yowalil syak' 40 libraok ixim harina winh yet' nok' ch'ak kalnel chi'. Haxo yet' nok' kelemtak kalnel chi', hato ha' jantak tz'el t'a sk'ol winh yak'ani. Ha yet' 40 libraok ixim harina, syak' pax nanhal schanhil litro aceite winh.
Haxo t'a sk'ual ayik tz'alji k'een uj, yowalil syak' junok nok' kelem wakax winh, wakwanhok nok' kelemtak kalnel yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel. Masanil juntzanh nok' chi', malajokab' spaltail nok'.

Ha yet' nok' kelem wakax chi' syak' 40 libraok ixim harina winh. Icha pax chi' tz'aj yak'an jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' winh. Haxo pax yet' nok' kelemtak kalnel chi', yalnhej jantak tz'el t'a sk'ol winh yak'ani. Haxo yet' junjun 40 libraok ixim harina chi', syak' nanhal schanhil litro aceite winh.
Ayik tz'och winh yajal t'a spuertail schab'il amak' chi', tz'och winh t'a corredor chi', hanheja' ta' tz'elxi winh.

Ayik tzul och heb' chonhab' ejmelal t'ayin t'a junjun q'uinh, yowalil a tik sk'ulej heb': Ha mach tz'och t'a b'ab'el amak' t'a spuertail, t'a stojolal norte, ha t'a puerta t'a stojolal sur tz'elxi. Haxo mach tz'och t'a puerta t'a stojolal sur chi', ha t'a puerta t'a stojolal norte chi' tz'elxi. Malaj junok mach smeltzajxiel t'a puerta b'aj ix ochi, palta to tz'el t'a junxo puerta k'elankot b'aj ix och chi'.
Ha winh yajal chi', yowalil tz'och winh yet' heb' chonhab', tz'el pax winh yet' heb'.

Ha t'a niwak q'uinh yet' sk'ual molanil, syak' 40 libraok ixim harina winh yajal chi' yet' junjun nok' kelemtak wakax. Icha pax chi' ixim syak' winh yet' junjun nok' ch'ak kalnel. Haxo pax yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel, yalnhej jantak tz'el t'a skol winh yak'ani. Ha yet' junjun 40 libraok ixim harina chi', syak' pax nanhalok schanhil litro aceite winh.

Ayik tz'el t'a sk'ol winh yajal chi' yak'an junok nok' silab' t'ayin, junok nok' snhusjitz'aok, ma junok nok' yik junk'olal, yowalil sjakchaj puerta t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, syak'an silab' winh chi', icha syak' winh t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip. Slajwi chi' tz'elxita winh t'a puerta chi', ichato chi' smakchajxikani.

Junjun q'uinhib'alil t'a junjun k'u syak' silab' winh yajal chi' t'ayin. Yowalil syak' junok nok' kelem kalnel winh, yik snhusjitz'a nok' silab'il t'ayin, jun ab'il sk'inal nok', malaj jab'ok spaltail nok'. Ha yet' jun nok' kelem kalnel chi', syak' pax 14 libraok ixim harina winh yet' junok litro aceite sekchajem t'a yib'anh ixim. Ha jun tik, yowalil sk'anab'ajej winh t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Tato a winh yajal chi' siej jab'ok lum smakb'en t'a junok yuninal, a jun lum chi' tz'ochkan smakb'enok yuninal chi'.

Palta tato a winh yajal chi' siej jab'ok lum t'a junok schekab' yik smakb'enej, masanto sjawi ab'il yik tz'el tas t'a libre, ichato chi' syik'anxi lum winh yajal chi'. Haxo skan lum smakb'enok heb' yuninal winh.

Ha winh yajal chi', malaj yalan yik winh stok'anek' smakb'en junokxo anima. Ha lum sluum winh, a lum syak' winh smakb'enok heb' yuninal. Icha chi', malaj heb' malaj smakb'en skan t'a skal in chonhab', xchi Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anb'at jun winh winak chi' t'a yoloch sti' jun puerta, t'a chab' pat yik heb' sacerdote skan t'a stojolal norte. Ix sch'oxan winh t'ayin t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a spatik chab' pat chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: Haton t'a tik yowalil ol stz'anh nok' silab' heb' sacerdote tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup mul, ma yuj stojolok mul. Ha t'a tik ol b'ochaj pax ixim harina tz'ak'ji ofrendail. Icha chi', max ik'chajel juntzanh tastak chi' t'a b'ab'el amak', yik wach' max ochkan stzikikial juntzanh tas yik Dios yaj t'a heb' anima, xchi winh t'ayin.
Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anelta winh t'a jun b'ab'el amak', ix in yik'anek' winh t'a schanhil pak'anh.
Ix wilan t'a junjun schikintak amak' chi', ay juntzanhxo yunetak amak'. Lajan yechel schanhil. 20 metro steel, 15 metro sat.
Ha t'a spatiktak juntzanh yunetak amak' chi', ayk'e jun muro nab'a k'een, haxo t'a yichtak jun muro chi', ayk'e b'aj tz'och k'ak'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: Haton t'a juntzanh kusinu tik stz'anh nok' silab' heb' smunlaj t'a templo tik, haton silab' syak' heb' chonhab', xchi winh t'ayin.
